name: Crafting & Alchemy
description: Gather materials in the world, then craft at two benches: a BALL WORKSHOP in Cerulean turns apricorns into Poke/Great/Ultra Balls, and an ALCHEMY LAB in Celadon mixes herbs into Potions and status heals. Materials come from foraging spots on routes (refill weekly) and a chance drop after winning wild battles. The benches are interactive menu screens that show each recipe's cost and craft on select.
